# LN Photogrammetry

> Drone-based photorealistic 3D (Gaussian splat) capture service for real estate listings in Lake Nona and greater Orlando, FL. $275 flat rate per standard property, 48-hour typical turnaround.

## Service
- Aerial drone capture of a property's exterior and grounds
- Gaussian splat (3D Gaussian Splatting) processing into a photorealistic, web-embeddable 3D model
- Delivered as a hosted, shareable link for use on listing pages, MLS (where supported), and social media

## Pricing
- $275 flat rate per property (1-2 story homes, standard Lake Nona lot sizes)
- Custom quote for larger lots, multi-acre properties, or gated communities
- Bulk / recurring rates available for realtors listing multiple properties per month

## Area served
Lake Nona, FL and the greater Orlando, FL area.
